summary.tldr: Creates a federal strategy for eye care and designates February as Age-Related Macular Degeneration Awareness Month.
what_it_does: Requires the Health Minister to develop a national strategy for preventing and treating eye disease, and for vision rehabilitation, after consulting provinces, Indigenous groups and other stakeholders.
Says the strategy must describe different forms of eye disease and may cover training needs, research, data collection, and sharing information between governments.
Allows the strategy to include a way to rapidly examine certain drug and device applications under the Food and Drugs Act for eye diseases.
Requires the minister to hold at least one conference while developing the strategy.

Requires a report on the strategy within 18 months, and a follow-up report on its effectiveness and the state of eye disease prevention and treatment within five years after the first report is tabled.
Declares February to be Age-Related Macular Degeneration Awareness Month across Canada.
